title: Fix settings key canonicalization and BDPGS default drift
summary: Fail closed on non-canonical settings patch key casing and align missing BDPGS OCR settings display defaults with the contract default.
reason: Settings preview/save could accept case-variant canonical keys as raw extras while exact-key validation ignored them, and several settings/launch display helpers treated missing ConvertBdpgsToSrt as enabled despite the contract default being disabled.
behavior_before: Case-variant settings keys such as routingprofile could bypass canonical validation or fail late, and partial settings payloads could display BDPGS OCR as enabled/coherent when the contract default is disabled.
behavior_after: Settings preview/save reject non-canonical casing for known config keys with an actionable canonical-key message, and BDPGS OCR display/readiness fallbacks match the disabled contract default.
manual_validation: Focused unittest suite currently fails because settings_patch_candidate_facade.py reintroduced unknown-key rejection branches during validation; see final handoff.

rollback_plan: Revert the canonical-key validation helper, BDPGS fallback changes, docs, tests, and this packet. This change does not mutate media files, queue state, or publish state.
